name: Kazuraha
source:
A demon that appears in She's Supposed to be Dead. [spoiler]She is the main antagonist of the work.[/spoiler]

[spoiler]She was accidently unsealed early on in the VN by the protagonist. She is posing as Risa in disguise.[/spoiler]
